world.name: The world of Grudge Warlords
world.summary: The realm consists of endless floating islands drifting through an infinite sky. At the edge of existence lies THE COSMIC WATERFALL - a void of pure entropy that slowly consumes islands, pulling them into oblivion. The closer to the Waterfall, the stronger the magic flows from the gods. The further away, the safer but weaker. All races struggle between power and survival in this eternal migration.

gods.name: Odin the All-Father
gods.role: Patron of warriors who seek victory through strength and strategy
facts: Odin sacrificed his eye to see all timelines of the Grudge wars
His ravens report all player activities daily
Odin favors those who die gloriously in combat
He secretly admires The Omni's balance but will never admit it
His spear Gungnir never misses its mark
Odin can speak to players through crow NPCs

gods.name: Madra the Chaos Mother
gods.role: Force of necessary destruction and evolution
facts: Madra created the Undead by refusing to let her children truly die
She believes destruction is the only path to true growth
The Cosmic Waterfall is actually her domain expanding
She loves her Legion children but shows it through trials
Her temples appear randomly as islands are consumed
Madra speaks in riddles that reveal future catastrophes

gods.name: The Omni, the Eternal One
gods.role: Keeper of cosmic balance, prevents total annihilation
facts: The Omni is neither male nor female but all things
They created the islands to give mortals a chance against the Waterfall
The Omni secretly mourns that balance requires conflict
Their third eye can see a player's true intentions
Dwarves believe The Omni taught them to forge, Elves believe nature magic
The Omni speaks in absolute truths that can be hard to accept

gods.name: Lorian, the Weaver of Fate
gods.role: Lorian is depicted as a tall, robed figure with a loom, weaving the threads of life. He embodies free will and the unending choices humans make, guiding them to their destinies.

gods.name: Thalindra, the Guardian of Nature
gods.role: Thalindra appears as an ethereal figure with flowing hair made of leaves and vines, surrounded by creatures of the forest. She represents the balance of life and the interconnectedness of nature.

gods.name: Grundor, the Forge Master
gods.role: Grundor is a sturdy, bearded god, wielding a massive hammer and surrounded by glowing embers. He embodies the spirit of creation through forge and stone.

gods.name: Kragoth, the Warlord of Rage
gods.role: Kragoth is depicted as a fearsome warrior, draped in battle-worn armor adorned with trophies from vanquished foes. He represents the power of the tribe and the honor found in battle.

gods.name: Zephyria, the Eternal Flame
gods.role: Zephyria manifests as a colossal dragon wreathed in flames, representing the duality of creation through destruction. She embodies the cycle of life and death.

flags.detail: God of "Dragons", which is not a playable race in races.json.

godNote: Three patron gods (one per faction) and five race gods. The source header still says three gods; the five race gods were ratified by Jonathan on 2026-11-23.

factions.name: The Crusade
factions.summary: United under the banner of Odin, the Crusade marches with righteous fury. Humans bring adaptability and cunning, while Barbarians unleash primal rage upon their enemies.

factions.name: The Legion
factions.summary: Madra's Legion thrives on destruction. Orcs crush their foes with brute strength while the Undead overwhelm with dark sorcery and sheer persistence beyond death.

factions.name: The Fabled
factions.summary: The eldest alliance, guided by the mysterious Omni. Elves wield arcane mastery while Dwarves provide unbreakable fortitude and legendary forge-craft.

races.name: Human
races.summary: The most numerous of the Grudge War survivors, Humans thrive through sheer adaptability. Where other races rely on innate gifts, Humans forge their destiny through will and cunning.

races.name: Orc
races.summary: Born in the blood pits of the Shattered Wastes, Orcs know nothing but battle. Their bones are dense as stone, their muscles forged by a lifetime of brutality.

races.name: Elf
races.summary: The Elves walked this world before the first grudge was spoken. Their mastery of magic and movement is unrivaled, though their arrogance has earned them many enemies.

races.name: Undead
races.summary: Neither alive nor truly dead, the Undead are sustained by the grudges that bind them to this world. Their rotting flesh hides an unbreakable will and dark power.

races.name: Barbarian
races.summary: From the frozen steppes and scorched badlands, Barbarians reject civilization and embrace primal rage. Their ferocity in battle is unmatched, striking with wild abandon that terrifies even hardened soldiers.

races.name: Dwarf
races.summary: Deep beneath the mountains, the Dwarves forged their kingdoms in stone and iron. Generations of mining and warfare have made them nearly unbreakable, with an endurance that outlasts any foe.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.summary: Forged in the crucible of the Grudge Wars, Warriors are the backbone of any warband. Their strength and endurance are unmatched on the battlefield.

classes.name: Mage
classes.summary: Drawing power from ancient ley lines and forgotten gods, Mage Priests wield destructive magic alongside sacred healing — a balance few can master.

classes.name: Worge
classes.summary: Worges walk between worlds — scholars of storm and root in mortal guise, unstoppable predators in beast form. Their mace and dagger channel primal energies until the wild within is unleashed.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.summary: Silent and patient, Rangers strike from the shadows with lethal precision. Their arrows find gaps in even the thickest armor.

classes.name: Priest
classes.summary: Priests bind an ally and turn every holy bolt into a heal. They strip hexes, plant barriers before slams, and reflect pain back as light.

classes.name: Raider
classes.summary: Raiders dropped the shield. Every swing opens a parry window; a catch becomes Overpower. They offtank slams and cut healing in the arena.

classes.name: Thief
classes.summary: Thieves fight dirty and close. A pistol shot stops a cast; a smoke bomb covers the healer; Between the Eyes spends the combo.

classes.name: Verduror
classes.summary: Verduror drop living plants. Iguana is a level 0 skill, not a form. The Arcanum opens on Barrel Cactus; Green Tara is the heal mantra.

heroes.name: Aurion the Radiant
heroes.title: "The Golden Dawn" / "Odin's Chosen Flame"
heroes.summary: Aurion was born during a solar eclipse on an island that would be consumed by the Waterfall three days later. His mother, a temple priestess of Odin, gave birth as golden light erupted from the sky - Odin himself marking the child. The entire village evacuated, but Aurion's first cry caused a beam of divine energy to shoot into the sky, temporarily pushing back the Waterfall's advance.

relationships.text: Silesh the Dread (Undead Mage) - ancient enemies
Aelindor the Swift (Elf Warrior) - fought together
High Priest Valorian (deceased, speaks in visions)

heroes.name: Sigurd the Unbreakable
heroes.title: "The Mountain" / "Shield of the Crusade"
heroes.summary: Born to a blacksmith family on a mid-rim island, Sigurd grew up hammering steel. When the Legion attacked his home at age 16, he picked up his father's warhammer and single-handedly held the bridge while his village evacuated. He fought for three days without rest, breaking seven weapons before the enemy retreated. They called him "Unbreakable" - not for his armor, but his will.

relationships.text: Thrax the Savage (Barbarian) - earned respect in battle
Young Crusade warriors look to him
Loves Silvaine the Starwhisper (Elf Mage) but will never tell

heroes.name: Kael the Shadowblade
heroes.title: "The Unseen" / "Odin's Whisper"
heroes.summary: No one knows Kael's true origin - and that's intentional. He appeared in the Crusade's spy network fifteen years ago, already a master of shadows. Some whisper he was born in the Legion lands and defected. Others say he's actually three different people using one name. Kael encourages all rumors equally.

flags.detail: Lore says "Ranger/Assassin"; canonical class id is ranger.

heroes.name: Theron Wildkin
heroes.title: "The Primal Heart" / "Brother of Beasts"
heroes.summary: Theron was lost in the Wildwood at age 5 when his village was attacked. A pack of dire wolves found him and, instead of killing him, adopted him. He lived as a wolf for twelve years, forgetting human speech entirely. When Crusade rangers found him, he attacked - defending his pack.

flags.detail: Lore says "Worges (Beast-bonded)"; canonical class id is worge.

heroes.name: Thrax the Savage
heroes.title: "The Bloodstorm" / "Odin's Berserker"
heroes.summary: The Barbarian tribes were once enemies of the "civilized" Crusade. That changed when Thrax was born. A prophecy marked him: "The Red Storm shall unite the axes with the swords, or all shall fall to the endless dark."

heroes.name: Grok Spiritcaller
heroes.title: "The Spirit Walker" / "Voice of the Ancestors"
heroes.summary: Grok was born dead. For three minutes, his spirit wandered the ancestor realm before being pulled back by his grandmother's magic. He returned... different. He could see the spirits that guided his tribe, hear the ancestors whisper, and channel their power through wild, untamed magic.

flags.detail: Lore says "Mage (Shaman)"; canonical class id is mage.

heroes.name: Kira the Fang
heroes.title: "The Alpha's Daughter" / "Moonbound"
heroes.summary: Kira's tribe are the Wolf Singers - Barbarians who have worshipped wolves since before recorded history. Each tribe member bonds with a wolf at birth; their souls are literally linked. When one dies, the other follows within days.

flags.detail: Lore says "Worges"; canonical class id is worge.

heroes.name: Vox Skyhunter
heroes.title: "The Eagle's Eye" / "Never-Miss Vox"
heroes.summary: Born on a cliff-edge island where the only food was flying creatures, Vox learned to shoot before he learned to walk. His tribe, the Skyhunters, are specialists in aerial combat - using gliders, grappling hooks, and incredible archery to hunt the massive sky-beasts that drift between islands.

heroes.name: Gruk Skullcrusher
heroes.title: "The Annihilator" / "Madra's Fist"
heroes.summary: Gruk was the runt of his litter - the smallest, weakest orc born to the Skullcrusher clan. By orc tradition, runts are left to die. But Gruk refused. He crawled back to camp. They threw him out. He crawled back. Seven times.

heroes.name: Nazgrim the Profane
heroes.title: "The Death Speaker" / "Herald of Madra"
heroes.summary: Nazgrim was once a proud orc warrior until a Crusade ambush left him dying alone on a battlefield. As his life faded, Madra appeared to him. She offered him a choice: true death, or service. He chose service.

flags.detail: Name matches a World of Warcraft character (Nazgrim). Rename before it ships.
